description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that feels like Express, runs at Fastify speed, and ships ready for edge, AI and serverless workloads.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the 2026 hype around edge AI and serverless by emphasizing that yantravese ships *zero* runtime dependencies, native TypeScript types, built‑in OpenTelemetry, and out‑of‑the‑box support for Cloudflare Workers, Deno and Bun. Position the package as the "Express‑style" developer experience with Fastify‑class performance and observability baked in, so search terms like *fast*, *edge*, *ai*, *serverless* and *type‑safe* boost its discoverability.
download_hooks: Developers pick yantravese for instant, zero‑config routing that feels like Express but runs 2‑3× faster on the edge.
Performance angle: native ESM, no runtime dependencies, and built‑in HTTP/2 & HTTP/3 support deliver sub‑millisecond latency even under heavy load.
Developer experience angle: full TypeScript type safety, auto‑generated OpenAPI docs, and integrated OpenTelemetry let teams ship reliable services faster.
